nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_embedding_compensation

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_weighted_square_identity

nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_norm_exists

nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_norm_functional

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_to_weighted_norm

nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_norm_transport
nodes.summary: The positive-definite weighted norm respects actual equality of both integer coordinates.

nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_norm_scaled

nodes.name: eisenstein_signed_product_scaled_right

nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_lagrange_compensation

nodes.name: eisenstein_weighted_norm_product

nodes.name: eisenstein_product_integer_congruence

nodes.name: eisenstein_omega_product_covariance
nodes.summary: The genuine coordinate rotation for multiplication by ω commutes with right multiplication; this small bilinear identity recovers imaginary associativity from real associativity.

nodes.name: eisenstein_product_associate_imaginary

nodes.name: eisenstein_product_associate

nodes.name: eisenstein_coordinate_norm_conjugate

nodes.name: eisenstein_conjugate_product_is_norm

nodes.name: eisenstein_natural_scalar_product
nodes.summary: Multiplication by a natural real Eisenstein scalar is actual coordinatewise scaling.

nodes.name: eisenstein_adjoint_product_is_norm_scale
nodes.summary: The Eisenstein adjugate identity conjugate(a)*(a*b)=N(a)*b follows from checked coordinate associativity and the actual conjugate product.

nodes.name: eisenstein_residual_conjugate_identity
nodes.summary: Multiplying the actual residual a-bq by conjugate(b) yields exactly the numerator error conjugate(b)*a-N(b)*q.

nodes.name: eisenstein_product_commute
nodes.summary: Genuine Eisenstein multiplication is commutative on represented integer coordinates.

nodes.name: eisenstein_product_conjugate
nodes.summary: Actual Eisenstein conjugation preserves multiplication for all signed coordinate representatives.

nodes.name: eisenstein_product_shuffle
nodes.summary: The checked commutative Eisenstein product admits four-factor interchange without expanding a quartic polynomial.

nodes.name: eisenstein_coordinate_norm_product
nodes.summary: The genuine Eisenstein norm is multiplicative, from checked conjugation, commutativity and associativity, without a norm or polynomial oracle.

nodes.name: eisenstein_coordinate_norm_zero
nodes.summary: A genuine Eisenstein norm can be zero only when both represented integer coordinates are zero, with no sign-normality or positivity hypothesis.

nodes.name: eisenstein_coordinate_norm_nonzero
nodes.summary: Every nonzero represented Eisenstein integer has a strictly positive natural norm.

nodes.name: eisenstein_natural_norm_coordinates
nodes.summary: The natural fundamental-parallelogram norm is exactly the signed-coordinate norm of the same nonnegative integers.

nodes.name: eisenstein_signed_euclidean_division_exists
nodes.summary: Construct a genuine Eisenstein quotient and remainder for every nonzero signed divisor, with exact a=bq+r and strict actual norm decrease; neither quotient, norm existence, nor a bound is supplied as a premise.

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_of_representation

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_for_representation
nodes.summary: The canonical Eisenstein norm equals the actual norm of every representative of the same pair of integers.

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_exists
nodes.summary: Every canonical Eisenstein integer has a genuinely constructed natural norm, including zero and all units.

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_functional
nodes.summary: The canonical natural Eisenstein norm is unique, independently of all signed-coordinate representatives.

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_exists_unique
nodes.summary: Every valid canonical Eisenstein code has one actually computed and uniquely determined natural norm.

nodes.name: eisenstein_add_exists
nodes.summary: Eisenstein addition is exactly the shared neutral ZPair addition, with its already-checked constructive existence theorem.

nodes.name: eisenstein_add_functional

nodes.name: eisenstein_multiply_of_representations

nodes.name: eisenstein_multiply_for_representations

nodes.name: eisenstein_multiply_exists

nodes.name: eisenstein_multiply_functional
nodes.summary: Eisenstein multiplication has one literal canonical output code, not merely equivalent signed representatives.

nodes.name: eisenstein_norm_multiply
nodes.summary: The actual canonical Eisenstein norm of a product is exactly the product of the two actual natural norms.

nodes.name: eisenstein_division_remainder_of_representations

nodes.name: eisenstein_euclidean_division_exists

nodes.name: EisensteinCoordinateProduct

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance

nodes.name: ZPairRep
nodes.summary: The shared pair code represents the two supplied signed differences, with arbitrary nonnormalized representatives allowed.

nodes.name: ENorm
nodes.summary: The actual norm a²−ab+b² of the shared canonical pair code representing the Eisenstein integer a+bω.

nodes.name: EMul
nodes.summary: Actual multiplication in the Eisenstein ring, using the shared signed-pair carrier and the law ω²+ω+1=0.

nodes.name: ZPairAdd
nodes.summary: Actual coordinatewise integer addition in the shared signed-pair carrier. Both quadratic integer rings use this identical additive relation.

nodes.name: EDivRem
nodes.summary: The genuine canonical Eisenstein equation a=bq+r, witnessed by the Eisenstein multiplication graph and the very same shared pair addition as for Gaussian integers.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: EEuclideanDivision
nodes.summary: Actual Eisenstein quotient and remainder codes satisfy a=bq+r and have genuine norms U=N(r), V=N(b) with strict decrease U<V. The norm and operation witnesses imply valid pair codes.

nodes.name: SignedDifferenceSquare
nodes.summary: The natural value s of the integer square (p−n)², expressed as a subtraction-free balanced equality.

nodes.name: WeightedSignedNormThree
nodes.summary: The witnessed sum (ap−an)²+3(bp−bn)². It supports the proved identity 4N(a+bω)=(2a−b)²+3b², not a new norm axiom.

nodes.name: EisensteinSignedDivisionRemainder
nodes.summary: The genuine signed-coordinate Eisenstein equation A=B·Q+R, actual coordinate norms U=N(R), V=N(B), and strict decrease U<V.

nodes.name: ZPairDecode
nodes.summary: The shared injective code of two original canonical signed integers, with their normalized coordinate decoders. Both quadratic integer rings use this same carrier.

nodes.name: ZPairValid
nodes.summary: The natural z actually encodes a pair of signed integers; not every natural is assumed to be a valid pair code.

nodes.name: SignedFloor
nodes.summary: The genuine signed floor equation (p−n)=m·(q−t)+r and strict natural remainder bound r<m.
